message: spanProcessor sits next to a spread this tool can't read, so it was left as it is. 3.0 reads only spanProcessors (an array). Move it by hand.

NodeSDK gets options from ...loadConfig(), which this tool can't read. Where they set spanProcessor, metricReader or logRecordProcessor, 3.0 wants spanProcessors, metricReaders or logRecordProcessors (arrays).
